component.name: Icon
component.description: Renders an icon from a UnoCSS icon class, JSX element, or render function.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: name
own.description:
Icon source. Strings should be Uno icon classes such as `i-lucide-search`
or app-config aliases such as `icon-search`.
Non-string values can be JSX nodes or render functions.

own.name: ref
own.type: JSX.HTMLElementTags["div"] extends { ref?: infer Ref; } ? Ref : never | undefined

own.name: size
own.description:
Explicit icon size override. Omit to inherit the surrounding font size.
Numbers are interpreted as px.
